verdict.rationale: Bolt's docs describe a built-in Bolt Database that adds database functionality to your app "without the hassle of extra infrastructure." They also describe a Supabase alternative (hosted SQL, auth, edge functions) you can select during project creation, so provisioning happens inside the builder. One hands-on report shows a user adding a SQLite database within Bolt but hitting errors after running out of tokens; that is a reliability caveat rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how the database is wired into app code (schema/migrations, connection setup), and independent corroboration that provisioning works end to end.
